To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose an extension of the WSN model and we propose a distributed, secure, scalable algorithm for the secure exclusion of compromised sensors from a WSN.
a Supervisor, with very little interaction with the network, can enforce a secure exclusion from a WSN.

a distributed, cooperative and parallel algorithm for secure selection exclusion can be designed for a WSN model where the Supervisor has limited interaction with the sensors, it can be implemented in a way to have low computational overhead and a low number of transmitted messages, it is scalable since it requires only local knowledge of the topology and it can be adopted in other models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a secure and efficient algorithm for the exclusion of a sensor in a large scale ad hoc network.

the design and implementation of a secure and efficient protocol for selective exclusion in wireless ad hoc sensor networks, where the Supervisor is a mobile entity with limited interactions with the sensors, and it is asynchronous in its actions.
the development of a new model for ad hoc sensor network and the design and implementation of a secure, scalable and efficient algorithm for the new model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our model and algorithm is a significant contribution to the field of WSNs.
we have designed an efficient, scalable, and secure protocol for selective exclusion of compromised nodes in ad-hoc wireless networks.
the proposed algorithm is a secure, efficient, scalable and general solution to the problem of excluding a selected compromised sensor in a wireless sensor network.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we propose a novel model for ad hoc sensor networks and an algorithm that enforces secure exclusion in this new model.
we have proposed a new model, we have designed a distributed, scalable, secure algorithm for this model and we have shown that this algorithm can be used as an independent layer for other models.
we propose a new model for WSN and an innovative, efficient and scalable algorithm to enforce secure exclusion for this model.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, by using the proposed model and algorithm, the Supervisor can exclude from the network the compromised sensors in a secure, scalable, efficient and cooperative manner.
a small number of powerful nodes can be used to enforce security in a large number of less powerful nodes.
, by introducing an external entity with limited interaction with the network, we can significantly simplify the protocol and the overall complexity of the system.
